inline_prompts: There are N dice. The i-th die has K_i faces, with the numbers A_{i,1}, A_{i,2}, \ldots, A_{i,K_i} written on them. When you roll this die, each face appears with probability \frac{1}{K_i}. You choose two dice from the N dice and roll them. Determine the maximum probability that the two dice show the same number, when the dice are chosen optimally. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N K_1 A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \dots A_{1,K_1} \vdots K_N A_{N,1} A_{N,2} \dots A_{N,K_N} Output Print the answer. Constraints - 2 \leq N \leq 100 - 1 \leq K_i - K_1 + K_2 + \dots + K_N \leq 10^5 - 1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^5 - All input values are integers.

There are N dice.  
The i-th die has K_i faces, with the numbers A_{i,1}, A_{i,2}, \ldots, A_{i,K_i} written on them.  
When you roll this die, each face appears with probability \frac{1}{K_i}.  
You choose two dice from the N dice and roll them.  
Determine the maximum probability that the two dice show the same number, when the dice are chosen optimally.  
The answer is correct if its absolute or relative error from the true value is within 1e-8.  
Input  
The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:  
N  
K_1 A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \dots A_{1,K_1}  
\vdots  
K_N A_{N,1} A_{N,2} \dots A_{N,K_N}  
Output  
Print the answer.  
Constraints  
- 2 \leq N \leq 100  
- 1 \leq K_i  
- K_1 + K_2 + \dots + K_N \leq 10^5  
- 1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^5  
- All input values are integers.
